{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io, json
s='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,freight
SUP-001,164,56.53,781
SUP-002,324,137.19,441
SUP-003,168,99.98,799
SUP-004,217,83.66,454
SUP-005,363,124.67,189
SUP-006,233,17.23,154
SUP-007,64,57.17,700
SUP-008,373,134.81,599
SUP-009,61,82.1,154
SUP-010,266,93.01,518
'''
ex=Decimal('1.1379'); duty=Decimal('0.0427'); q=Decimal('0.01')
out=[]; tot=Decimal('0')
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(s)):
 a=(Decimal(r['quantity'])*Decimal(r['unit_price'])+Decimal(r['freight']))*ex*(1+duty)
 ar=a.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 print(r['record_id'], a, ar)
 out.append({'record_id':r['record_id'],'amount':format(ar,'.2f')})
 tot += ar
print(out)
print(tot)
PY"}
